evidence:
RUNTIME FACT LIST (skill quality-checks.md section 4), each traced to a public line and to its consumer. Entry path and start command: integration.md:3 'Put the finished app in /app. I start it with node /app/server.js from a working directory that may be outside /app. Resolve files from their actual location.' matches test.sh:68 and test.sh:97-111 (no cd, entry may be /tmp/submission/server.js). Port and bind: integration.md:3 'Listen on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0 (PORT is set to 3000 at launch)' matches test.sh:108 PORT=3000 and every prompt URL http://localhost:3000. Health path: integration.md:3 'answer GET /api/health promptly' matches test.sh:48 and app_context.md 'Health address'. Storage and DB_PATH: integration.md:9 'Use SQLite for persistent records. The default database path is /app/app.db. If DB_PATH is set, open that absolute path instead, including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app.' matches test.sh:98-109. Injected NODE_PATH and the available packages: integration.md:5 'The launch image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH' matches test.sh:106 and tests/Dockerfile (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1). No install/build at launch: integration.md:5 'opening the finished app must not require an install or build step' (test.sh runs none). Symlink refusal at test.sh:72-83 is told at integration.md:11. Restart: integration.md:7 and :9 and behaviour.md:9 'survive a complete server restart'. Seed: instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 name /assets/seed_data.json and say it has no user snippets (seed is {"snippets": []}; environment/Dockerfile copies it and the six notes, and instruction.md:3 'six notes' equals the six files). Accounts: instruction.md:5 'without signing in', overview.md:3 'without accounts', policy.md:3, agreeing with app_context.md 'Accounts: None'. Fixed clock: not applicable - no criterion grades a date or clock-derived figure; the only timing facts graded (five-second run budget, about five seconds for library refresh) are stated in behaviour.md:5 and :11 and the criteria allow about ten seconds. Network is public, nothing to state. test.sh is byte-identical to the frozen template's.

GRADED-IS-ASKED, every criterion mapped. Gates: cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing -> instruction.md:5 and overview.md:3; cw_custom_document_surface -> ui.md:3 (same list of banned surfaces and editors, and the same allowance for a small plumbing input); cw_shared_saved_record -> behaviour.md:9 'A fresh page must read the saved record from the running app' and integration.md:7. Functional editor criteria (typing/join, navigation and readout, graphemes, mouse selection, selection replace and one-step paste undo, block indent, caret in view with Ctrl+Home/End, long line, the three multi-caret criteria including the slow burst, undo restoring the caret) -> ui.md:5, :7, :9 sentence by sentence. Find/replace criteria (literal dot and bracket, wrap, replace current moving on, replace all as one undo and redo cleared by a new edit, self-containing replacement) -> ui.md:11. Colouring -> ui.md:13 (five JS and four HTML categories, same colour at declaration and call, no fixed RGB). Format criteria -> ui.md:15. Run criteria (basic output, HTML preview, error message and one-based line incl. whole-file HTML line, unhandled rejection, output kept before failure, fresh document, console order, fresh interaction budget, last-good picture with typed values and canvas, time limit, Stop, newer Run supersedes) -> behaviour.md:3, :5, :7. cw_preview_isolation and cw_dynamic_code_refused -> security.md:3, :5 (own routes and outside addresses must fail; eval, Function, WebAssembly, workers, dynamic import refused with feedback; words in strings/comments harmless). Persistence and concurrency (save/reload/restart, stale save refused, stale save keeps draft, history inspect/restore, repeat-safe restore over ordinary HTTP, live library update, live update keeping draft/caret/scroll/undo, newer-revision notice) -> behaviour.md:9, :11, :13 and integration.md:7. Polish: keyboard way out of the editor shown on screen, labels, feedback in words after Run/Save/Format, focus back to the code after Format/Undo/Redo/replacement/Save, Undo/Redo disabled after New and after opening, unsaved marker, 390 px -> ui.md:9 and :17. Visual: editor, layout and finish of the surfaces overview.md:3 and ui.md:17 ask to be shown together. Reverse direction for app_context.md Key screens: every named control (title, filename, Undo, Redo, Format, Find, Replace, line/column readout, Run, Stop, New, Save, preview, console, library, history) is requested in ui.md:5, :9, :11, :15, :17. No criterion names a route, selector, schema or exact wording, consistent with policy.md.

ADVERSARIAL READS. Conforming alternative that could fail on an unstated fact: an app that follows integration.md literally (resolves files from __dirname, opens DB_PATH, listens on 3000, bundles its own node_modules as real files) launches under test.sh; I found no launch assumption it would trip. Broken app passing because a fact is unstated: none in this row's scope. The scripted golden evidence (hashes verified) launched the reference as test.sh does (uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH, NODE_PATH, cwd outside /app) with one real restart, which supports that the stated contract is sufficient to launch; it is not a configured judge run on these bytes, and none exists.

NOTES (not defects for this row). (1) test.sh:110 launches as uid 65534 with HOME=/tmp/submission; the brief never says the process is unprivileged. Impact is bounded because integration.md:9 fixes where the database goes and test.sh:87-102 makes that location writable, but an app that writes scratch files elsewhere than its own directory or the DB_PATH directory is not warned. (2) cw_console_levels_in_order grades console.warn, console.error and console.info; behaviour.md:3 says only 'Show console output in the order it was written' without naming the methods - a fair reading, but implied. (3) cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus requires each control and the library to be reachable by keyboard; ui.md:17 says 'show keyboard focus' and asks for a keyboard way out of the editor, which implies but does not literally state keyboard reachability of library entries. (4) cw_caret_navigation_and_line_numbers requires ArrowLeft/ArrowRight to cross a line break; ui.md:5 lists 'arrows' without spelling this out - ordinary editor behaviour. (5) cw_save_reload_restart and cw_stale_save_refused ask the judge to read 'its revision' and count revisions; the brief asks for history inspection (ui.md:17, behaviour.md:13) rather than a displayed revision number, so the judge must derive it from the history list.
